== Summary ==
Identified: none. Three players with beers at a station, posted as Danish players. The bald player is heavier than the 2024 portrait of [[Jonas Hagen Nørregaard]]. Faces unlabeled.
Danish players on their way to Zu den Vier Winden for the [[2022 European Championship]].

* '''Event:''' [[2022 European Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2022-09-09
* '''Identification:''' the people are not named in the post.
